name: Borderlands 4: Bounty Pack 2 - Legend of the Stone Demon
summary:
Bounty Pack 2 takes you into abandoned mines alongside Defiant Calder to end human sacrifices to the Stone Demon. Explore an ancient cavern filled with Ordonite-encrusted enemies, three minibosses, and a final boss to defeat powerful new Pearlescent-rarity loot. The pack includes a Vault Card with mecha- and kaiju-themed cosmetics and gear to unlock through gameplay.

New Content:
• New mission featuring four new bosses that can drop 10 new pieces of powerful Legendary and Pearlescent loot
• Added rewards including a new Vault Hunter Skin, new Digirunner vehicle, and a new ECHO-4 Drone Skin
• Vault Card featuring 24 cosmetics and 4 rerollable pieces of gear to unlock through gameplay
